title: Side-stream first-pass delta
shortVerdict: Created a Norway-first CAR-005 registry delta for side streams, upcycling and ingredient actors.
strongestSource: Actor-primary pages for HOFF, Biomega, Hofseth BioCare, Pelagia and Alginor plus Brreg API checks
weakestPoint: Brewery, bakery, fruit/vegetable and smaller urban side-stream actor coverage remains incomplete.
gapType: Type A for source/dedupe follow-up; Type B for actor-scale and product-split details
ikkeSi: Do not equate utilized residual raw material with high-value human-food utilization.
Do not count group and production-site entities twice.
Do not present project targets as realized production.

title: Arctic Natural Nutrition parked
shortVerdict: Arctic Natural Nutrition was retained only as a parked identity row because no primary source confirmed side-stream/upcycling activity.
weakestPoint: No actor-primary product or circular mechanism source was found in this pass.
ikkeSi: Do not classify as circular actor from NACE alone.
Do not infer side-stream mechanism from nutrition-product purpose text.
Do not add to verified export until actor evidence appears.

title: Gruten as dormant/failure-context case
shortVerdict: Gruten was kept as a historically important coffee-ground upcycling case, but not as an active producer because its own site says the mushroom farm closed and the AS is winding down.
weakestPoint: Clean Brreg org-number match was not found in this pass.
ikkeSi: Do not list Gruten as active food producer.
Do not treat historic coffee-ground mushroom production as current production.
Do not infer company status without legal follow-up.
